facts.fact: Starlink launched commercial operations in Kenya in July 2023 as the first LEO satellite broadband provider; households and businesses buy kit (rental Sh1,950 a month) and packages such as 50 GB for Sh1,300.
Subscribers: 24,999 at 2026-03, per the Communications Authority of Kenya, 0.9% of the fixed internet market; Business Daily also cites 8,063 in June 2024.

Starlink suspended new sign-ups in Nairobi, Kiambu, Mombasa, Machakos, Murang'a, Kirinyaga and Kwale counties as capacity was exhausted, redirecting buyers to a waitlist, seen on 2026-07-07; a provider suspension, not a regulator ban.
